h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Darbhanga

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Darbhanga

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Darbhanga

c: Darbhanga is the cultural centre of Mithila in north Bihar, known for its ponds, its Madhubani painting tradition and its medical college. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Darbhanga to schools, colleges, hospital campuses, municipal parks and residential colonies. The Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away, and come by road.

Floods are a regular part of life in north Bihar, and many grounds in and around the town go under water in a bad monsoon. An outdoor gym here has to be planned with that in mind. Raise the gym area above the level that usually floods, grout every post into concrete, and pick machines whose seats and pedals sit high enough to be cleaned easily. The walking paths around the town's ponds are good places for an open gym, as people already come there in the morning.

richText.heading: An open gym beside a pond walk

c: Along a pond walk, set machines on a raised strip of paving next to the path. The

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment survive floods in Darbhanga?
items.a: Grouted footings hold the machines in place, and galvanised frames and plastic parts do not rust or rot. After floodwater drains, wash off silt and check the moving parts before use.

items.q: Can a hospital campus in Darbhanga use an open gym?
items.a: Yes. Low-impact machines such as air walkers, tai chi wheels and seated twisters suit staff and recovering visitors. We can mark a quiet corner on the layout.

items.q: How do we get a layout drawing?
items.a: Send the site size, a few photos and the type of users to sales@funplaysystems.com. We will suggest machines and send a drawing with the clear zone for each.
